start_here: Say to your AI: "Mark lesson grip of first-principles done." It runs tool:mark-a-lesson-done for the signed-in learner.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it adds one row to the done table of the pursuit database, once per learner and lesson.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:mark-a-lesson-done and the input.
3. Read the answer: whether a row was added (saved true) or the lesson was already done (saved false). Show it with the screen the tool names.
